name: Blackstone Valley Boys & Girls Club Summer Program
description_short: A 10-week weekday recreational and educational summer program for ages 6-13, held at a park on the Blackstone River with an outdoor pool and sports fields. Families choose a Basic day (9:30am-3:30pm) or an Extended day (7:30am-5:30pm).
refund_policy_summary: No refunds after the program starts. The $20 annual membership fee is never refunded.
swim_waterfront_notes: The park has an outdoor inground swimming pool, and campers can swim. The park sits along the Blackstone River, and fishing is offered.
